desc.zh: 从共享一个字符开始，推导后缀长度表并重建最短字符串。
desc.en: Share one letter, derive a suffix-length table, and reconstruct a shortest string.

complexity: O(mn + m + n) time; O(mn + m + n) space, including output

concepts.name: Shortest common supersequence suffix DP
concepts.description: Derive and reconstruct an optimal common supersequence.

concepts.name: Supersequence hand calculation
concepts.description: Share characters while preserving both input orders.
